dialogDescription: Give it your notes, a topic or a file. You'll check and edit every card before it's added.
notesPlaceholder: Lecture notes, a textbook passage, a vocabulary list…
topicPlaceholder: e.g. The causes of the French Revolution
topicHint: Be specific: include the level or exam if it matters.
fileHint: A PDF, or a photo or screenshot of notes or a page (PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF). Up to 8 MB.
generatingHint: This can take up to a minute for long material.
previewHint: AI can make mistakes. Edit anything that's wrong and untick cards you don't want.
previewEmpty: The AI couldn't find anything to make cards from. Try longer or clearer material.
added: {count, plural, one {# AI card added. Check it before you study.} other {# AI cards added. Check them before you study.}}
usageLeft: {left, plural, one {# AI request left this month} other {# AI requests left this month}}
mockNote: Sample output: this server uses a test AI, not a real model.
quotaTitle: You've used this month's AI requests
quotaUpgrade: Premium includes {count, number} AI requests a month.
suggestDone: Added. Check it before you study.
explainLabel: AI explanation. It can be wrong.
distractorsDone: Multiple-choice questions in this set now use AI-written wrong answers.
distractorsNone: Every card already has AI-written wrong answers.
distractorsPartial: {count, plural, one {# card still needs wrong answers. Run it again to finish.} other {# cards still need wrong answers. Run it again to finish.}}
needsVerify: Confirm your email address to use AI features. We sent you a link when you signed up.
